samplesheet.title: Samplesheet
samplesheet.description: One row per Xenium section. Pick each section's Xenium output folder (the folder holding cell_feature_matrix.h5 and cells.parquet).

dataset_name.title: Dataset name
dataset_name.description: Title shown at the top of the browser

default_gene.title: Default gene
default_gene.description: Gene to color by when the browser opens (e.g. Gfap). Leave empty to color by cluster.

schema.title: Samplesheet
schema.description: One row per Xenium section. Pick each section's Xenium output folder (the folder holding cell_feature_matrix.h5 and cells.parquet).

sample.title: Section name
sample.description: Label shown above the section in the browser
sample.errorMessage: Letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores only

xenium_dir.title: Xenium output folder
xenium_dir.description: The Xenium Onboard Analysis output folder for this section

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: Optional, e.g. genotype or treatment. The browser can split sections by it.

age.title: Age / timepoint
age.description: Optional. The browser can split sections by it.
